title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization helps prevent overfitting by adding a penalty to the model's complexity. L1 regularization (Lasso) and L2 regularization (Ridge) apply different penalties. Can you think about how these penalties might affect the choice of the lambda hyperparameter?

title: Exploring Lambda's Role
text: The lambda hyperparameter controls the strength of the penalty in regularization. A larger lambda means a stronger penalty. Consider how this might influence the model's coefficients differently in L1 and L2 regularization.

hintAnswer: L1 regularization can lead to sparse solutions, while L2 regularization tends to shrink coefficients evenly.
title: Comparing L1 and L2 Regularization
text: Which of the following statements is true about L1 and L2 regularization?
choices: L1 regularization can lead to sparse solutions, while L2 regularization tends to shrink coefficients evenly.
L1 and L2 regularization always result in the same model coefficients.
L1 regularization is always better than L2 regularization.

title: Lambda's Consistency
text: Think about whether the optimal lambda for minimizing error is influenced by the type of regularization used. Does the penalty type affect the model's performance on the validation dataset?
